Online course

Learn to describe, design and test software architecture, with exam-style practice if you want it.

Fourteen lessons that follow the topics of the iSAQB Foundation curriculum. Each lesson has eight slides you control, a field guide, a worked case, five recall questions and a lab. Across the labs you build one architecture file for a system you know. Five timed mock exams and a curriculum map help if you plan to sit the iSAQB CPSA-F exam.

03How it teaches

Built from how people learn

Short lessons you control

Eight slides a lesson, each with a transcript. Move at your own pace and go back whenever you like.

One growing architecture file

After every lesson a lab asks you to write real architecture work for your own system or the ClinicBook case: context, quality scenarios, building blocks, interfaces, runtime and deployment views, decisions and a review. The 14 sections join into one file you download at the end.

Mapped to the public curriculum

Every lesson is mapped to the learning goals of the iSAQB CPSA-F curriculum 2025.1. A curriculum map shows which lessons cover which goals and which goals are examined (R1), may be examined (R2) or are not (R3).

Five timed mock exams

Five different papers of 40 questions, balanced by chapter, with single choice, choose-several and allocation questions. They are original Intellica practice questions, not real exam questions. A report shows your score by chapter and learning goal, time used and confidence.

AI in architecture work

One lesson covers where AI assistants help, where they mislead, how to verify what they produce and how to record provenance. It is Intellica extension content beyond the current curriculum.

Mark your own work

Each lab has a model solution and a four-criterion rubric. Score yourself 0, 1 or 2 on each, then close the gaps. The health check only confirms the file is complete.

Pause and recall

Five questions at the end of each lesson, with the reason for each answer. Your progress is stored in this browser only.

Retrieval practice and spacing are among the best-studied learning techniques, so each lesson ends by asking what you remember before it shows you.

    06Questions

    Before you decide

    Who is this for?

    Developers with some team experience who are new to architecture, and anyone preparing for the iSAQB Foundation exam who wants a structured path with practice.

    Do I need an earlier level?

    No. This is Level 1. Some experience building or maintaining software helps, and basic object-oriented and UML ideas are assumed.

    Is this an iSAQB course or the official exam?

    No. It is independent Intellica self-study that follows the topics of the iSAQB CPSA-F curriculum 2025.1. Intellica is not an accredited training provider. The exam is booked separately with an iSAQB certification body, and training is not required to sit it. Check the current exam format and rules with the certification body before you book.

    Are the mock exams real exam questions?

    No. They are original Intellica practice questions written from the public curriculum topics. They do not predict your result. The question bank is a first edition and will grow.

    How do I get access?

    Pay by bank deposit from the buy button on this page, then upload a photo of the receipt. If the automatic check reads it cleanly, your course opens at once. If it cannot read the receipt, your course still opens at once as provisional access and the owner is told to check it against the bank statement; if the payment cannot be confirmed, access is closed again. Your access code is a decryption key and cannot be recalled once issued, so keep it private.

    Can I share my code?

    Please do not. The code is personal and your name appears on every lesson.

    What about refunds?

    Free lessons come first, so you can try before you pay. You can ask for a refund within 7 days of payment by WhatsApp, saying why, and we repay the account you paid from within 10 business days. After a refund your access code is withdrawn and you agree to stop using the course. No refund once you have claimed a certificate. If the course does not work as described and we cannot fix it, you get a full refund even after 7 days.
